messages:
Jordan (New Hire): Hey team — quick set of onboarding questions I didn't want to clog email with:
1) I moved the week I signed the offer. Can I still file the relocation/moving reimbursement? Any deadline?
2) My commuter pre-tax card arrived but it says 'inactive' when I try to tap. Who do I ping to get it activated?
3) I'm starting part-time — how are company holidays handled / prorated? Will I get floating holidays?
4) Tiny W-4 question: I submitted the form but need to change the withholding; is that done via self-serve or do I need to send something to payroll?

Maria (People Ops): Welcome, Jordan! :tada:
Short answers:
1) Yes — moving reimbursements are still eligible if the move date is within 60 days of your start date. Please open an expense with receipts.
2) Commuter cards are handled by payroll/benefits depending on the card vendor. @Devon can advise on activation.
3) Part-time holiday prorate: we prorate based on scheduled FTE for the current calendar year. You should have 0.6 FTE on file, right?
4) W-4 edits: self-serve in ADP for federal/state; if you change after payroll cutoff we'll need a manual update for the current cycle. If you DM me your preferred withholding I'll confirm the cutoff date.

Jordan (New Hire): Thanks Maria — yes, I'm at 0.6 FTE. I'll open the expense now. What's the exact expense category name?

Devon (Payroll): Hey Jordan — for the commuter card activation I can trigger a reissue/activation with the vendor. Can you DM the last 4 of the card and the card name? I'll also check if there's a vendor portal issue.

Sam (Benefits): Hi Jordan, for holidays: part-time folks are prorated to FTE and get the same set of company holidays (no floating by default), but managers can approve unpaid time as needed. If you'd prefer an extra floating day, talk to your manager and we can mark it in the HR record.

Jordan (New Hire): OK DM'ing the card details now. Expense question — which category? "Relocation" or "Moving - One-time"?

Maria (People Ops): Use "Relocation - Moving Expense" if it's a covered move. If it's a small shipping or temporary housing reimbursement use "Relocation - Misc." Add receipts and the signed relocation form (upload PDF).

Jordan (New Hire): Got it. Where do I submit — Concur or the internal portal?

Maria (People Ops): Internal expenses portal: https://expenses.redwood.com and then select "Relocation". If you hit any validation errors, paste the screenshot here and we'll escalate.

Devon (Payroll): Also FYI about W-4: you can update via ADP > Myself > Tax Withholding. Changes submitted before Friday 6pm PST will apply to next payroll. After that, we might need to do a retro update.

Jordan (New Hire): Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll submit now and follow up if activation doesn't complete.

Payroll Bot: Payroll run scheduled: next cutoff 2024-04-05 18:00 PST. Any manual changes after cutoff will apply to the subsequent pay period. :robot_face:

Maria (People Ops): tagging to close loop — once relocation expense is submitted, ping me and I'll approve quickly so it goes through next finance review. Congrats again and welcome aboard! :wave:
